summary: Fidelity Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K on July 29, 2026, declaring monthly distributions and a variable supplemental distribution for its common share classes. Gross distributions are $0.1750 per share for Class I, S, and D, with stockholder servicing fees reducing net payouts for Classes S and D. A supplemental distribution of $0.0160 per share was also declared. Payments are due on or about August 31, 2026, to shareholders of record July 31, 2026, in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. The filing also disclosed June 30, 2026 NAVs (~$24.70 per share) and portfolio metrics, including a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.88x.
